name: Shimadzu Corporation
summary: Shimadzu Corporation provides equipment solutions in Japan, the United States of America, Europe, China, rest of Asia, and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Measuring Equipment, Medical Equipment, Industrial Equipment, and Aircraft Equipment Business.
